rooms.name: An Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc: This is a map room of zone 183.  There is a map taped to the wall here.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
You are in the north-west corner of the board in a gleaming red tiled plaza.
There are exits to the east and south.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is the north-west section of the main plaza.  This particular section of
the plaza is made up of black tiles.  There is a wall to the north and exits 
lead in the other cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This is the north-west section of the plaza.  This section is made up of small
red tiles in an ornate pattern.  There is a wall to the north but there are
exits to the east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is basically the north-center of the main plaza.  This section of the
plaza is made up of semi-circular black tiles.  There is a wall to the north
north and exits lead in the other cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
You are basically about the center of the plaza right at the north wall.  This
area is made up of small, triangular red tiles.  Exits lead east, west, and
south.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
You are in the north-east section of the of the plaza.  This area is made of 
a black streaked stone.  Exits lead east, south and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This is the north-east section of the main plaza.  This little square is made up
of small, irregular red stones, much like little cobbles.  You can leave west,
south, or east.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is the north-east corner of the plaza.  This area has a smooth-as-glass,
gleaming black floor.  You can leave south or west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
Along the west wall in the north-west section of the plaza.  The floor is a 
rough black surface.  You can leave to the north, east, or south.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
You are in the north-west section of the main plaza.  This area has a slick red
floor.  Exits lead north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
The north-west section of the main plaza.  This small zone is made up of very
small black tiles.  Exits lead in all the cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
You are in the north-east corner of the plaza.  The floor is made of flat, red
stones.  Exits lead in the four basic directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
You are in the north-east section of the plaza.  The floor here is covered by
a fine black gravel.  Exits lead north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This small area in the north-east part of the plaza is made up of very large
slabs of dull red stone.  Exits lead north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
In the north-east section of the main plaza, this square is made up of chunks of
mismatched black stone.  Exits lead in all compass directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
Along the east wall in the north-east of the plaza, this square's floor is made
up of a hard packed red clay.  Exits lead north, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This is along the west wall in the north-west area.  The floor here is made up
of small red beads that appear to be glued to the ground.  Exits lead north, 
east, and south.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
In the north-west section of the plaza, this very plain looking square with a
black floor has exits in all of the cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
The floor of this room is some covered with some kind of pine needles, which is
strange because there are no trees on the plaza.  Exits lead north, south, east,
and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is moss growing on the ground here, covering the original color of the
floor.  This moss is a black, icky looking thing.  Exits lead in the four basic
directions from here.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a thick, red, shag carpet here.  Because of the carpet it seems
very quiet.  Exits lead north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
In the north-east section of the plaza, this open area is made completely up of
a single slab of onyx.  Exits lead in the four directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This is in the north-east section of the main plaza.  The room is all done up
with red painted wood.  There are exits to the north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This room has a mute, black, indescribable feel to it.  Directly to your
east is the east wall.  Exits lead north, west, and south.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
Along the west wall this square is made up of a fine black stone, inlayed with
a little gold.  Exits lead to the north, east, and south.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
A richly ornated area, this place in the north-west portion of the plaza has
many comfortable items that are all done in a tasteful red.  Exits lead in the
four basic directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
In the north-west area of the main plaza, this mini-plaza is done in a low pile
carpet.  It is a charcoal gray, almost black, in color.  Exits lead north,
south, east, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This area is coated in a fine red powder.  It is in the air and dries
out your throat very quickly.  Exits lead in the four cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
It is very dark here, although the sun still gives its light.  It seems that
all the items are sucking up the light, making it have a black feel to it. 
Exits are to the north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This area in the north-east quadrant of the plaza is done in a gothic, but
tasteful decore.  Unfortunately, the only color is black.  Exits lead north,
south, east, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This square looks like it could be a garnet mine.  There is little flakes of the
red stone imbeded into the walls and floor.  A wall is directly to the east
here.  Exits lead north, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There are small red pebbles lying all over the place.  They fit nicely, 
thorough, and cause no problems walking or running.  There is a wall to the
west.  Exits lead north, south, and east.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is a dingy, dank, and dark place.  It is kind of surprising to see here
in the ordinarily bright plaza.  Exits lead north, south, east, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
The walls and floor here are painted with a very gleaming red paint.  Why would
anyone actually do that to a place?  Exits lead in the four basic directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is a black tarp rolled out over this part of the plaza.  Maybe there is
some tile work they are trying to save from wear.  Exits lead in the four
cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
In the south-east section of the plaza, this area is covered with a plush red
material.  Exits head north, east, south, or west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is a mixture of black, gray, and gold tiles here to form an ornate
pattern.  Exits lead in the basic four directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a finely crafted mural made of small stones with colors ranging from 
white to pink to a deep red on the floor here.  Exits lead north, west, south,
and east.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is along the east wall.  The ground is made of a fine crushed black powder.
There is a iron gate to the east and exits lead to the north, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Gateway
rooms.desc:
This is a small platform in the middle of a vast ethereal light that leads up to
a heavy iron gate to the west.  There is a big sign posted here.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
A thin black mist rolls on the ground in this little square.  The wall is just
west of here.  Exits lead north, east, and south.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a high slab of red streaked stone used as the floor here.  Exits lead
in the four basic directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
The floor here is a very rough, broken mess of stones.  They are all black in
color which makes you worry about twisting your ankle or something.  Exits lead
in the four basic directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
In the south-west section of the main plaza, this room's floor is of a simple
tile pattern with little red tiles.  Exits lead in the basic cardinal 
dirctions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is a tightly formed mosaic on the floor here.  It has black, gray, and
gold tiles forming it.  There is an exit to the north, the south, the east, and
the west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This is the south-east section of the plaza.  The floor here is made of a neat
circle and triangle tiles fit together with a gray morter.  Exits are to the
north, south, east, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This floor is made of large black tiles fit together fairly loosely.  Exits 
lead north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This square is situated in the south-east section of the plaza, along the east
wall.  The floor here is made up of a strange red rock that is sort of gleaming.
Exits lead to the north, west, and south.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This square is along the west wall.  The floor is made of a red stone that
looks rounded.  It is used in a cobbled fashion.  Exits lead north, east, and
south.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is in the south west section of the main plaza.  The floor is a smooth,
checker pattern with black and dark gray patterns.  Exits lead north, east,
south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a fine red gravel on the ground here.  There are exits to the north,
south, east, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is in the south-west section of the plaza.  The ground is covered in a
thick, black water like substance.  It is rather gross.  Exits lead to the
north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a red surface here, though you don't know what it is.  It is not
really stone or wood, but it is safe to walk on.  There are exits in the four
basic directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is an ornate pattern made out of tiny tiles here, it must have taken
ages to construct.  There are exits in the four basic cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a basic red tile floor here in the south-east section of the main
plaza.  The exits are in the basic four directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
The east wall is just to your east here.  The floor is made up of a simple
triangle pattern with black tiles.  Exits head north, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is the south-west corner of the plaza.  The floor here is a simple black 
tile one.  Exits lead north and east.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
A wall is just to your south.  This square is made up a rough, red stone that
really doesn't look well cut or placed.  There are exits to the north, east,
and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This square is along the south wall.  There is a clean, black slate for the
floor here.  Exits head east, west, north.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
On the floor here is a complex pattern painted onto a white stone floor.  A
wall is just to your south.  Exits are east, north, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
Someone has created a swirl pattern with the small black tiles on the floor
here.  Exits head off to the north, the east, and the west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a spongy red material on the floor here.  Exits are to the north,
east, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is a strange soft black material covering everything except for a small
path in the square.  Could that be velvet?  There are exits to the west, east,
and north.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There a huge piece of red stone being used as the floor here.  There are viens
of gold running thru it.  To the east and south are walls.  Exits are to the
north and west.

rooms.name: Map Room for hill to labyrinth and checkers
The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the southeast
you see a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: Outside the Wizard's Retreat
rooms.desc:
A small shack, it's doorway with the actual door  long since destroyed by 
age, opens to the north.  In all other directions a grassy hilltop travels 
down.

rooms.name: In a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. A small hill rises up here to stop
at a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. To the west you see a small shack on
a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the northeast
you see a small shack on a tall hill.

You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the northeast
you see a small shack on a tall hill.

You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. A small hill rises up here to stop

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing

You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the northeast

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the 
northwest you see a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: In the Wizard's Shack
rooms.desc:
A small table and fireplace fill the north wall, and the door to the south is 
missing, leaving a hole to the outside world. On the west wall is a glowing red
portal, while a matching black one takes up the eastern wall. The table before
you is covered with board games and puzzle books, all in remarkably good shape.
A red, leatherbound book glows faintly where it lies, but resists all your 
efforts to pick it up.

rooms.name: The HITEC Lab
rooms.desc:
You are in a really cool lab, that your tax dollars paid for :)  This
place is so cool that it even has a police car with working lights in it.
This is the kinda place that all us computer geeks want to call home.

rooms.name: Orodreth's Quarters
rooms.desc:
This is the sleeping chamber of a meticulous mage.  There is nothing out of
place here.  It almost looks as though the person who uses this room, does not
actually need to sleep here.  There is a doorway to the east with a sign
hanging over it.

rooms.name: Orodreth's Library
rooms.desc:
All along the walls are huge floor-to-ceiling bookshelves full of books.  Some
are the newest releases from ORA and some are novels as old as time itself.
The knowledge that is contained on these shelves... it is amazing...
There are two exits on back into the main room which is to the west and a
small door on the north wall leads somewhere.

rooms.name: The Coding Room
rooms.desc:
You are in a large room by its dimesions, but not by the looks of it.  It
is cluttered with printouts, manuals, and snack wrappers.  There are two
large tables along the two of the walls and a large painting on the other.
You see a wonderful colection of hardware, which is all connected with a lag-
free internet link, must be nice.  The only door is to the south.
